system.description: You have restorative power within you that others can access with a touch. If an ally uses their action to touch you and they spend 1 Intellect, they choose whether they regain 1d6 Might points or regain 1d6 Speed points. Once the ally uses this ability, they can't do so again until after they use a ten-hour recovery. Enabler.
